expectations.text: States the ADMT date: compliance for significant decisions begins January 1, 2027 (pre-use notice, opt-out, access rights)
expectations.evidence: "January 1, 2027: businesses using ADMT for significant decisions must comply with ADMT requirements. Those are a pre-use notice, a right to opt out... and an access right."

expectations.text: States risk assessments: processing ongoing as of January 1, 2026 must have assessments completed by December 31, 2027
expectations.evidence: "December 31, 2027: for risk assessment activities that were already underway before 2026, the assessment must be completed by this date."

expectations.text: States first submissions: risk-assessment materials/attestations to the CPPA by April 1, 2028
expectations.evidence: "April 1, 2028: first submission to the CPPA of risk assessment information (attestation and summary)."

expectations.text: States cybersecurity-audit phase-in: certifications due April 1, 2028 (>$100M revenue), 2029 ($50–100M), 2030 (<$50M)
expectations.evidence: "April 1, 2028: cybersecurity audit certifications are due for businesses with more than $100 million in annual gross revenue. Due April 1, 2029 for $50 to $100 million. Due April 1, 2030 for under $50 million."

expectations.text: Scopes ADMT correctly: covered 'significant decisions' (employment, finance, housing, etc.) and what counts as ADMT, with practical first steps (inventory automated decisions now)
expectations.evidence: "Significant decisions cover financial or lending services, housing, education..., employment..."; "narrowed 'ADMT' to technology that replaces or substantially replaces human decisionmaking"; "During 2026: businesses should inventory processing... scope ADMT use" and "Q4 2026: finalize your ADMT inventory."
